title: The openDesk demo is positioned for the ZenDiS partner programme while its marketing-licence tender is unpublished
content:
The mechanism is an openDesk component dispatching typed operations on an administrative approval — an approval inside the German public-sector sovereign workplace stack, recorded outside the applications that make up that stack.

The positioning is explicit: the work is aimed at the ZenDiS partner programme. So is the blocker. The marketing-licence tender is still unpublished, tracked as procurement item T6, which means the commercial route the demo is designed to travel does not yet exist in a form anyone can respond to. The integration can be ready before the channel is, and conflating the two would misstate the state of play.

The single lead is B1 Systems GmbH in Vohburg, marked "3 · later". The priority and the unpublished tender are consistent: this is a position to hold rather than a deal to pursue, and the trigger to revisit it is a procurement event rather than anything about the lead.
